visualCharacteristics: Light background, bordered disclosure panels stacked vertically. Each panel has a bold heading with a rotating chevron affordance; expanding reveals a link list (contact links, phone numbers, audience links, email/social).
contentPattern: One row per panel: cell 1 = panel heading; cell 2 = body (a link list / contact content). Rendered as native <details>/<summary>.
usage: Sidebar 'Ask questions' style contact accordion with expand/collapse panels.
